components.css: .ds-win { background: var(--screen-1, #121720); border: 2px solid var(--frame, #44536a); border-radius: 6px; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px var(--screen-1, #121720), inset 0 0 0 3px var(--line, #2a3442); padding: 3px; width: 340px; } .ds-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; } .ds-mon { display: grid; justify-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 12px; color: var(--ink, #e3e8f0); text-decoration: none; box-shadow: inset -1px -1px 0 var(--line, #2a3442); } .ds-mon-no { justify-self: start; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; color: var(--ink-3, #8592a5); font-family: "DotGothic16", system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-mon-cur { width: 8px; height: 10px; fill: currentColor; shape-rendering: crispEdges; visibility: hidden; } .ds-mon-name { font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.9375rem; } .ds-mon-tag { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 22px; padding: 0 8px; background: #b24a1e; border-radius: 2px; color: #fff; font-family: "DotGothic16", system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-mon:hover, .ds-mon:focus-visible, .ds-mon.ds-is-selected { background: var(--select, #62b2ff); color: var(--select-ink, #06101c); outline: none; } .ds-mon:hover .ds-mon-no, .ds-mon:focus-visible .ds-mon-no, .ds-mon.ds-is-selected .ds-mon-no { color: var(--select-ink, #06101c); } .ds-mon:hover .ds-mon-cur, .ds-mon:focus-visible .ds-mon-cur, .ds-mon.ds-is-selected .ds-mon-cur { visibility: visible; }

components.css: .ds-meters { display: grid; gap: 8px; width: 360px; } .ds-meter { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 5.5rem 2.75rem 1fr; align-items: center; gap: 12px; } .ds-meter-label { font-family: "DotGothic16", system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.8125rem; letter-spacing: 0.02em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--ink-3, #8592a5); } .ds-meter-value { font-family: "DotGothic16", system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.9375rem; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; text-align: right; color: var(--ink, #e3e8f0); } .ds-meter-track { height: 10px; background: var(--screen-0, #0b0e13); border: 1px solid var(--frame, #44536a); border-radius: 2px; overflow: hidden; } .ds-meter-fill { display: block; height: 100%; background: var(--meter-high, #62b2ff); transition: width 420ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-meter-mid .ds-meter-fill { background: var(--meter-mid, #e3b341); } .ds-meter-low .ds-meter-fill { background: var(--meter-low, #e0503f); }

narrative.overview:
The site is the in-game Pokédex, rebuilt for today. It is a numbered list and a live entry page that always show the chosen game. It is not a dashboard of sprite cards under a wall of filter chips. Everything sits on a dark, cool slate screen. Content lives inside double-ruled Game Boy windows. Selection works like the device menu: a drawn ▶ cursor and inverse video. A dot-matrix pixel face carries the device's voice: numbers, headings, labels, tabs, buttons and the dex text. A plain system sans carries names and reading text, so a lookup made on a phone in a few seconds stays legible.

Density is high but ordered. The browse Pokédex is one window whose cells are split by hairline rules. With an entry open, the grid becomes a 336px numbered list beside the entry page. On phones, cells become numbered rows and a bottom tab bar holds the sections. Motion is short and functional, with one signature moment: the dex text types itself into a dialog box, a ▼ prompt blinks, and ◀ ▶ (arrow keys or a swipe) steps to the neighbouring entry.

The world is dark only, in slate greys and blues. Green never appears in the chrome. Fills are flat: no gradients, glows or glass.
keyCharacteristics: Dark slate screen ramp as the only neutrals; one bright blue for selection and nothing else.
Double-ruled window frames (frame rule, gap, hairline) for every major container.
Inverse-video selection with a drawn ▶ cursor, on dex cells, tabs, menu rows and the phone tab bar.
DotGothic16 for the device voice, system sans for names and prose, Pixelify Sans for the wordmark only.
Pixel icons drawn on a 12×12 grid with crisp edges, in one stroke weight.
Tabular figures everywhere numbers line up.

rules.name: The No Green Rule
rules.body: Nothing in the chrome is green: no buttons, states, meters, success marks or accents. Green appears only where a type colour is the data.

rules.name: The One Selection Colour Rule
rules.body: Cursor Blue means "selected, current or focused" and nothing else. The page's main action is inverse ink (Ink fill, Screen Off text), never blue, so blue keeps its meaning.

rules.name: The Red Is The Device Rule
rules.body: Pokédex Red is for the wordmark plate and stamps. It is not a call-to-action colour.

rules.name: The Pixel Voice, Sans Names Rule
rules.body: The device speaks in DotGothic16: numbers, headings, labels, tabs, buttons and dex text. Names and anything read as prose use the UI sans. Pixelify Sans was the first pixel face. It was demoted to the wordmark because its 5 reads as S and its B/C read as G/O.

rules.name: The Near-Zero Tracking Rule
rules.body: DotGothic16 is monospaced. Pixel text keeps 0 to 0.04em tracking; small pixel text stays at 0 to 0.02em.

rules.name: The One Face Per Number Rule
rules.body: A figure is set in one face. A number is never split between the pixel face and the sans. Tabular figures are on site-wide.

rules.name: The No-Zoom Field Rule
rules.body: Form fields render at 16px on touch screens (`pointer: coarse`) so iOS never zooms the page.

rules.name: The Flat Screen Rule
rules.body: Fills are flat. No gradients, glows, blurs or glass. A surface rises by changing tone and frame, and floats only when it is a popover.

dos: Do put every major container in a double-ruled window (2px Frame Rule, inset hairline, 6px corners).
Do show selection as inverse video in Cursor Blue (#62b2ff) with Screen-Off Ink, plus the ▶ cursor where the item is a list or tab.
Do set numbers, headings, labels, tabs, buttons and dex text in DotGothic16, and names and reading text in the UI sans.
Do keep tabular figures and keep each number in one face.
Do keep the chosen game visible as the context on every Pokédex view.
Do mark status in place with a stamp rather than hiding the item.
Do use three meter tiers, blue / amber / red.
Do draw new icons on the 12×12 pixel grid with crisp edges.
donts: Don't use green anywhere in the chrome. Type colours on type tags are the only exception.
Don't use Cursor Blue for anything that isn't selection, current or focus. That includes the main action, which is inverse ink.
Don't use Pokédex Red as a button or accent colour. It belongs to the wordmark and stamps.
Don't add gradients, glows, blurs or glass, or cast shadows on anything that doesn't float.
Don't use Pixelify Sans outside the wordmark.
Don't set form fields below 16px on touch screens.
